[[Aarhus N]] | capacity = 5,000 (100 seated) | chairman = Lars Kruse | manager = Mathias Damgaard | league = [[Danish 1st Division]] | season = [[2025–26 Danish 1st Division|2025–26]] | position = Danish 1st Division, 8th of 12 | website = {{URL|http://www.aarhus-fremad.dk/}} | pattern_la1 = _pumaclassic25fy | pattern_b1 = _pumaclassic25fy | pattern_ra1 = _pumaclassic25fy | leftarm1 = FFDD00 | body1 = FFDD00 | rightarm1 = FFDD00 | shorts1 = 000000 | socks1 = 000000 | pattern_la2 = _pumaclassic25b | pattern_b2 = _pumaclassic25b | pattern_ra2 = _pumaclassic25b | leftarm2 = 000000 | body2 = 000000 | rightarm2 = 000000 | shorts2 = FFFFFF | socks2 = FFFFFF }} '''Aarhus Fremad''' ({{IPA|da|ˈɒːˌhuˀs ˈfʁɑmˌɛð|lang}}, "Aarhus Forward") is an [[association football]] club located in [[Aarhus N]], the northern part of [[Aarhus]], Denmark. The club competes in the [[Danish 1st Division]], the second tier of the [[Danish football league system]]. Aarhus Fremad competed in the lower divisions of Danish football until 1997, when the club miraculously reached the [[Danish Superliga]] after nine promotions in 13 seasons. The club's home ground is the [[Riisvangen Stadium]]. The [[East Jutland metropolitan area|East Jutland]] club was originally formed as sports club in 1897, before being refounded as an independent association football club in 1947."}}
